critical_code_review_comments: validate_uuid in core.py is clean and reusable — raises HTTPException(422) which FastAPI surfaces correctly. Good pattern.
/auth/me returns the right shape for both user types and uses .maybe_single() correctly to avoid 500 on missing rows.
Alias routes use stacked @router.get decorators on the same handler — minimal, idempotent, no duplication. Same shape returned.

BranchContext.setActiveBranch is wrapped in useCallback with the localStorage write inside try/catch — robust against quota/privacy-mode errors. Initial fetchBranches prefers persisted id → falls back to is_main → falls back to data[0]: correct precedence.
AgendaPage.js: replaced unkeyed Fragment with <Fragment key={…}> inside slots.map — verified 0 console warnings on live render.

appointments.py: inline imports of sync_appointment_to_gcal at the 3 callsites resolves the F821 NameError. Acceptable, though a single module-level import would be cleaner. Cosmetic ruff E701 warnings noted but intentionally left.

Pre-existing item from iter 21 still applies: appointments.py POST/PUT does not validate that branch_id belongs to caller's clinic — recommend adding ownership check (low severity, RLS-protected on read).
